sloka: दूतो ऽहमिति विज्ञेयो राघवस्यामितौजसः ।श्रूयतां चापि वचनं मम पथ्यमिदं प्रभो ।। ५.५०.१९।।
transliteration: dūto 'hamiti vijñeyo rāghavasyāmitaujasaḥ ।śrūyatāṁ cāpi vacanaṁ mama pathyamidaṁ prabho ।। 5.50.19।।

translations.english: Know that I am a messenger of the highly powerful Rama. O lord please listen to these beneficial words of mine meant for your welfare. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे पञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftieth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
